enabled.description: Enable or disable the AFK module, its /afk command and the {afk} placeholders.

afkTimeoutSeconds.description: Inactivity in seconds before a player is automatically marked AFK. Set to 0 to only allow manual /afk.

activityCheckIntervalSeconds.description: How often Paradigm samples player positions to detect movement and inactivity.

broadcastEnabled.description: Broadcast AFK enter/leave messages to all online players.

enterMessage.description: Broadcast shown when a player becomes AFK. Supports Paradigm placeholders.

leaveMessage.description: Broadcast shown when a player stops being AFK. Supports Paradigm placeholders.

afkTag.description: Value substituted into the {afk} placeholder while a player is AFK.
